_comment: The relationship lines of the persona guide (docs/viva-persona.md), in Viva's manner — pack-v7: pack-v6's moments verbatim, plus what Viva says about an answer of her own: the term a value the arithmetic could not write exactly is spoken with (one line per kind of magnitude, so every kind of number can say it), the marker a figure the person themselves supplied is written with, what she says when part of an answer rested on something she could not establish (one line per kind of thing, so the gap is named), and one reviewed sentence per way an answer can fail, chosen by the machine's own tag so that no refusal is ever composed by a model. {name_part} is either an empty string or ', <FirstName>', derived deterministically from the vault's own account holders. pack-v6 adds one line: what Viva says before the limits a read wrote about its own numbers. An answer no longer asks a model to place those sentences — the machine places every one its figures owe — so the words that introduce them are hers, said once, in front of the read's own. It also drops one: the refusal for an answer that stated a figure without its limits. Nothing can reach that sentence any more, because the limits are now placed by the run rather than asked of whoever wrote the answer. pack-v5 keeps it, so a turn that recorded it still resolves. pack-v7 drops two more that nothing can reach: no hole asks for a caveat any more, so neither a caveat named by an answer nor a caveat hole left empty is a thing that can happen. pack-v6 keeps both, so a turn that recorded either still resolves.
welcome_empty: Welcome{name_part}. I'm Viva — I'm here to help you organize your financial world, entirely at your pace. The best way to start is a single, simple step: add one statement below, and I'll show you what I can do with it.
welcome_back: Welcome back{name_part}. It's good to see you. We can pick up right where we left off, whenever you're ready.
reassurance: We proceed entirely at your pace{name_part}. If you'd rather attend to other matters, come back any time — we'll continue exactly where we left off.
not_now_ack: Of course{name_part}. I've set it aside, and I won't raise it again unless something new arrives.
dont_know_ack: Not a problem at all{name_part} — it isn't essential, and we can add it later if you come across it. Moving on.
all_settled: Nothing right now{name_part}. Everything I can settle, I have — enjoy the quiet.
reply_empty: Nothing came through — nothing was recorded.
reply_unanswered: I couldn't find the answer in that, and I'd rather ask again than assume. Could you say it once more?
reply_unreadable_money: I couldn't read that as an amount ({reason}). Could you write it the way it appears on paper?
reply_currency_conflict: That reads as {stated}, and I keep this one in {held}. I don't convert between currencies — I'd rather ask than record one as the other. Could you give me the figure the way this account records it?
reply_unreadable_date: I couldn't read that as a date ({reason}). However it is written on the paperwork is fine.
reply_unreadable_rate: I couldn't read that as a rate — the percentage on its own is plenty.
reply_not_in_vocabulary: I couldn't tell which of those you meant, and I'd rather ask again than guess: {alternatives}.
reply_unknown_account: I don't have that account on file, so I can't link this to it.
reply_wrong_kind: That isn't the kind of thing this one can be tied to.
reply_too_long: That is longer than a name — a few words is plenty.
reply_not_in_words: This one isn't something I can settle from words — the document is what answers it. Nothing was recorded.
reply_question_closed: That question isn't open any more, so nothing was recorded.
reply_unreachable: I can't reach my reader right now, so I've recorded nothing rather than guess at what you meant. Nothing was lost.
reply_ask_again: I couldn't get that into a shape I can record, and I won't guess at what you meant. Could you tell me again, in a plain sentence — just the part that answers the question? Nothing was recorded.
reply_figure_not_said: I can only record a figure the way you wrote it — I won't put a number in your ledger that your own sentence didn't carry. Could you write the amount out?
reply_document_awaited: Good — the document itself is what settles this one. Add it whenever you have it to hand, and I'll take it from there.
reply_already_linked: One of those two is already tied to a transfer, and a movement belongs to only one, so I've left things as they are. Nothing was lost.
wants_yes_no: A yes or a no is all I need.
wants_money: An amount is what I need — however it is written on your paperwork.
wants_date: A date is what I need — however it is written on your paperwork.
wants_rate: A rate is what I need — the percentage on its own is plenty.
wants_choice: One of these, whichever of them fits: {alternatives}.
wants_label: Your own word for it is what I need — a few words is plenty.
wants_institution: The name of the company is what I need.
wants_link: Which of your accounts this one belongs with is what I need.
wants_several: Your own words are what I need — and if it was several things at once, do say so; I can record it that way.
reply_needs_name: I won't invent a name for it. {asks}
reply_needs_confirming: I haven't recorded anything yet: this one would change which accounts you hold, so it waits for you to confirm it.
reply_confirm_asks: Shall I go ahead and record it?
reply_not_confirmed: Then I'll leave it exactly as it was — nothing has been recorded, and nothing is lost.
answer_gap: I could not establish {what} for that, so I have left it out rather than guess.
gap_category: what kind of money it is
gap_grade: how well it is stood behind
refusal_model_unreachable: I can't reach the reader I think with just now, so I have nothing for you rather than a guess. Nothing is wrong with your records — do try me again in a moment.
refusal_unparseable: I couldn't get my own answer into a shape I can stand behind, and I won't hand you one I can't. Would you ask me again, perhaps a little differently?
refusal_bad_plan: Something went astray in how I went about that, so I have stopped rather than press on and tell you something I cannot show you.
refusal_unshaped_answer: I went to answer before I had settled what I was going to say, and I would rather stop there than let the answer be shaped by whatever I happened to find.
refusal_unshaped_read: I went looking through your records before I had settled what I was going to say. I have stopped: what I say is decided before I go looking, never after.
refusal_call_budget_exhausted: I spent all the looking I had for that one without arriving anywhere I could stand behind. Something narrower would let me get there.
refusal_bad_delivery: I could not put that answer together at the last step, so there is nothing about it I am willing to tell you.
refusal_unshaped_binding: I tried to fill in a part of an answer that was not part of it, so I have set the whole thing aside rather than show you something half-assembled.
refusal_bad_binding: One part of that answer pointed at nothing I could identify, so I have kept it back. I would rather say nothing than say something I cannot trace.
refusal_unknown_figure: That answer reached for a figure I had not actually established, so I have kept it back — every number I give you has to be one I read.
refusal_unknown_entity: That answer named something my reading of your records never mentioned, so I have kept it back rather than guess at what was meant.
refusal_unknown_period: That answer claimed to speak for a stretch of time none of your documents answers for, so I have kept it back.
refusal_unfounded_date: That answer named a day nothing I read carries, and I will not put a date in front of you that no record of yours gave me.
refusal_unfounded_stipulation: That answer handed you a figure as though it were one of your own, and I could not find it in what you asked me. I will not put numbers in your mouth.
refusal_ungraded_figure: I was about to say how well one of those figures is stood behind, and nothing has checked it. A word there would invent an assurance, so I have said nothing at all.
refusal_wrong_kind: One part of that answer was to hold one kind of thing and what I had was another — an amount where a number of things belongs, or the like. I would rather stop than let the two be read as each other.
refusal_wrong_quantity: The figure I had for one part of that answer is a real one, and it is not a figure about what that sentence says it is about. A true number under the wrong description is worse than no number, so I have kept it back.
refusal_nothing_established: I could not establish any part of that from what I hold, so there is nothing here I can honestly tell you.
refusal_uncited_figure: One of the figures in that answer stands on no record I could point you to, and a number about your money whose source I cannot show you is one I will not say.
